name: What plumbing permits do I need for a bathroom remodel in Berkeley?
description: Plumbing permits are generally required for altering existing lines, adding fixtures, or relocating drains and water supply lines in a Berkeley bathroom remodel

mainEntity.name: What plumbing permits do I need for a bathroom remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a bathroom remodel in Berkeley, you will typically need plumbing permits for any work involving altering existing plumbing lines, adding new fixtures, or relocating drains and water supply lines. This ensures the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. Always check with the City of Berkeley Planning Department or a licensed contractor for specific permit requirements related to your project before starting any work.
